contract.decision_source: R58 explicit new benchmark; not a reconstruction of historical deployments
contract.coordinates: original inputs converted to FP32, distances/checking accumulated in FP64
contract.objective: sum Euclidean travel distance; ATSP uses the original directed matrix
contract.capacity: raw capacity when present, otherwise normalized capacity=1; unlimited vehicles

backhaul.order: within each vehicle route all positive deliveries precede negative pickups
backhaul.capacity: sum of deliveries <= Q and sum of absolute pickups <= Q separately

time_windows.constraint: service START lies in [tw_start,tw_end]; early arrival waits
time_windows.speed: raw speed if supplied, otherwise explicitly fixed at 1
time_windows.departure: every vehicle starts at depot time 0 (raw depot_tw_start if supplied)
time_windows.depot_close: raw depot_tw_end if supplied; otherwise +infinity, NOT 3
time_windows.closed_return: return travel takes time and must meet an explicitly supplied depot close

contract.length: per-vehicle travel DISTANCE <= raw route_limit; excludes waiting and service
contract.open: a depot delimiter ends the route without return distance or return time; next vehicle starts afresh
contract.visits: every customer exactly once, depot can delimit any number of nonempty routes
contract.eligibility: locked per problem/deployment before validation/test solving, never per instance
contract.failures: stop publication; retain instance and failure evidence; no dropping or silently repairing tours
contract.ties: FP64 exact cost ties; native ind regenerated using first minimum in fixed global-ID pool order
contract.test_policy: same prelocked contract/deployments as train/val; no protocol changes from test results
contract.old_data: read-only; old costs/winners are not authoritative in scenario_v2
